reserveReview.rationale: The raw reserves API captured 2026-11-04T22:01:31Z reports totalAssets $124073600.16780875121112909 and totalLiabilities $123799337.046365292762574656. All positive rows are normalized without rounding through the reviewed adapter categories. Morpho Gauntlet USDG Premium is $3,305,763.144757 (2.664356591801944%) and Morpho Steakhouse USDG Pro is $839,951.408258 (0.676978347627514%). At Arbitrum block 521297920 (hash 0x75165f6a788e538c08918480d9744d30e57b590963d6c62b4f355045e7ed4087, 2026-11-04T21:57:16Z), asset() on both exact vaults returned tracked native USDG 0x004b506865409877c9fa29bfb1eba929984b9bbc; the Steakhouse vault also returned a positive balanceOf() for Reservoir adapter 0x289c204b35859bfb924b9c0759a4fe80f610671c. This establishes the held-vault underlying identity, not its borrower collateral or executable liquidity. The prior unlinked Steakhouse slice is replaced by the exact chain-and-address-keyed USDG collateral mapping. Credit, concentration, smart-contract and unknown liquidity risks remain explicit. The issuer API has no composition timestamp: compositionAsOf is the retrieval date, not a certified issuer period end. Equity $274263.121443458448554434 is balance-sheet context, not reserve capacity. Prior reviewed observation (2026-10-29, retained as history): The configured raw reserves API fetched 2026-10-29 reports totalAssets $115,828,521.96902596717579039 and totalLiabilities $115,580,352.796182594109878244. All positive rows are retained at unrounded precision and normalized through the reviewed adapter bucket rules: USDC positions 41.65844718130937%, USD1 lending markets 31.655365107742945%, AUSD lending markets 17.84495268906073%, USDG deposited in the Morpho Gauntlet USDG Premium vault 5.183559432958626% ($6,004,040.276582, Arbitrum vault 0x390c1bb01f3f627144a40617e287d4ce3d5abcfa), Agua Global Carry Vault 1.3500047359036067%, and GHO lending markets 0.7197792195496548%. The previous composition's Morpho Sentora PRIME PYUSD position is no longer present in the issuer balance sheet; no PRIME row was returned, so that slice is withdrawn. A new positive row, Morpho Steakhouse USDG Pro ($1,839,231.409524, Arbitrum vault 0xbeeff72b77e7584a450e887125f25e8d8819016a), has no reviewed adapter category and is retained as a 1.5878916334750728% insufficient-evidence slice rather than mapped by label. USDG is a reviewed bucket with tracked coin usdg-paxos. The $248,169.172843373065912146 equity line is retained as issuer-reported balance-sheet context, not reserve capacity. The issuer payload exposes no source composition timestamp; compositionAsOf is the 2026-10-29 retrieval date, not an issuer period end.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reservoir's balance sheet sits in protocol-controlled Asset Adapter and PSM contracts (the 2026-07-20 API rows resolve to adapter addresses 0x4809010926aec940b550d34a46a52739f996d75d, 0x3063C5907FAa10c01B242181Aa689bEb23D2BD65, 0x289C204B35859bFb924B9C0759A4FE80f610671c, and 0x8Cc5a546408C6cE3C9eeB99788F9EC3b8FA6b9F3), and neither the Terms of Service (2024-08-23) nor any docs.reservoir.xyz page reviewed today names a third-party custodian, trust, SPV, or holder claim on reserve assets, so no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented. Reserve re-use is the protocol's core yield model: docs state the balance sheet is allocated into RWA, lending markets, and DeFi strategies, and the ToS itself warns redemptions can lag when reserve assets must be sold or redeemed. Protocol admins (the PSM and Credit Enforcer DEFAULT_ADMIN is EOA 0xb7570e32 per the mint-authority review) can reallocate the balance sheet without holder consent. In the 2026-09-30 composition the PRIME exposure is a 3.5% PYUSD deposit in the Morpho Sentora PRIME lending vault; custody of that vault's borrower-side PRIME collateral sits upstream and is not documented by Reservoir. No named legal issuer entity is disclosed (Cayman Islands governing law only), so holder recourse in an insolvency is untested; wallet-level segregation inside the adapter contracts is not disclosed.
